method: Independent model linguistic review of exact retained English senses and Spanish semantic evidence; Spec conclusions not consulted; not native-human certification.
numbermode: human-collective English plural retained, not re-pluralized
context: Selected ordinary human collection sense: Spanish plural gentes can denote people/persons without changing the English human plural people into ethnonational peoples.
limitations: This is an exact selected-sense mapping, not a global morphological rule for English people.
Peoples remains valid for distinct nations/ethnic communities, including appropriately selected PUEBLO senses; those are not this selected human collection sense.
Do not conflate the separate Mexican colloquial singular-person sense of gente or the Pueblo sense with the selected collective sense.
No change to Spanish source plural morphology or grammatical feminine gender is implied.
